clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind's western edge, Park offers visiting night elves a haven amid the stone city. It lies between Cathedral Square and the Mage Quarter, with greenery and quiet for rest. Druid trainers here are the only ones in the Eastern Kingdoms.

Stormwind's Park brings a quiet stretch of wilderness into the stone capital. Once a place for the city's people to seek recreation, it became an enclave for night elf emissaries and travelers from across the Great Sea. Shaded canopies shelter the district, and a central Moonwell stands amid its grounds. The grove offers a glimpse of Kalimdor's sacred glades in the heart of the human kingdom.

Night elves have a foothold in foreign lands within the Park. Kaldorei priests such as Nara Meideros tend visiting pilgrims, while druidic mentors guide those devoted to the wild. Weary travelers can also rest from the clatter of the Trade District and the solemn duties of the Cathedral.
